# Mary Joe

## Appearance

Mary Joe is a young [French](../codex/factions.md#french) girl. She has a buxom build and a broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## History

As a young woman, Mary Joe had never seen anyone suffering from croup. While Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) was away, she was left to care for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) when the child fell severely ill with the condition.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII.
